prompt_en: A photorealistic photograph of an unmistakably adult woman with a long oval face, evenly spaced almond-shaped dark-brown eyes, a softly tapered medium-width jaw, a straight dark hairline, and long center-parted near-black wavy hair. She braces both gloved hands on a large vermilion handwheel and turns it beside a rain-swept elevated transit junction; the wheel opens a segmented stormwater gate, spilling silver runoff through grated channels. A medium three-quarter frame keeps her face large while both hands and wheel remain visible. A normal-lens eye-level view keeps facial proportions natural. One elevated off-axis key illuminates the near side of the adult face through haze. The nose shadow connects into the shadow-side cheek mass as one continuous shape. One contained inverted triangle of light remains beneath the far eye with closed edges. The shadow-side eye and facial structure remain readable without flattening the shadows or lifting the dark cheek mass. The joined shadow and cheek triangle distinguish the setup from split butterfly ring or generic side light across the adult face. Articulated rail-switch arms, cable loops, maintenance carriages, and steel arches recede through rain depth. Droplets bead on her graphite rain shell, hair, and sleeves. The machinery stays plausible, physically connected, and richly legible as one coherent operational environment.
negative_en: low resolution, illustration look, body distortion, over-processed retouching, unrealistic hands, distorted fingers, cartoon style
